title: Picking your first deck
goal: Choose a deck that's fun, strong right now, and easy to learn.

steps.html:
You know the rules. Now pick a ship. Three good ways to choose:

  1. A starter deck in the color you like. Cheap, complete and easy to upgrade.
  2. A beginner-friendly meta deck. These are decks winning tournaments right now that are also simple to play.
  3. Your favorite character. You'll play more if you love your Leader.

Before you buy:

  • Check the deck's guide in the Meta tab: game plan, key cards, what beats it.
  • Check prices: every card links to TCGplayer.
  • Play some games, even against a friend with a starter deck. You'll learn faster by playing than by reading.
Strong decks change every few months when new sets come out. Deckhand updates its tournament data every day, so come back to the Meta tab to see what's winning.

quiz.q: What's a good first deck for someone brand new?
choices: A starter deck or a beginner-friendly meta deck
quiz.why: Starter decks and simple meta decks are the easiest way in.

quiz.q: Where in Deckhand can you see which decks are winning tournaments now?
quiz.why: The Meta tab updates daily from recent tournament results.

quiz.q: Why might the best decks change?
choices: New sets add new cards every few months
quiz.why: New sets, and the yearly block rotation, change what's strong.
